der gyur pa'i phung po lnga ka yod pa'i phyir te/ gtso bo'i phyir na yan lag bsgrags// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhung las/ rang gi sa pa'i bzhi yin no// gzhan gyi sa pa'i gsum dang gnyis// zhes gsungs pa ni rang gi sa pa dang gzhan gyi sa pa'i las gang dang gang gi 'bras bu gang dang gang 'byin tshul 'chad pa'i skabs yin te/ rang gi sa pa'i las kyi 'bras bu rang sas bsdus pa yin na bral 'bras dor ba'i 'bras bu gzhan bzhi yod/ gal te gzhan gyi sa pa'i chos zag pa med pa zhig gi 'bras bu yin na/ rnam smin dang bral 'bras ma gtogs pa'i 'bras bu gzhan gsum/ gzhan gyi sa pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa zhig yin na/ 'bras bu gzhan gsum mi 'byin par skyes (308) bu'i byed 'bras dang*/ bdag po'i 'bras bu gnyis 'byin pa ni tshig rkang gnyis po de'i don yin no// rang gi sa pa'i zhes dang*/ gzhan gyi sa pa'i zhes drug sgra smos la/ 'grel par drug sgra ma smos kyang don 'dra ba yin no// bzhi pa thod rgal gyi skye tshul ni/ sa brgyad rnam gnyis 'brel ba dang*// gcig brgal song zhing 'ongs nas ni// rigs mi mthun pa gsum par 'gro// thod rgal gyi ni snyoms 'jug yin// zhes pas bstan/ 'di la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ sbyor pa la ring sbyor ni/ tshig rkang dang pos bstan/ de'i don ni/ sa brgyad ces pa ni gang la snyoms par 'jug pa'i bzhi/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug brgyad/ rnam pa gnyis ni zag bcas dang zag med gnyis yin zhing*/ 'brel pa ni thar chags su 'jug pa yin no// des na dngos gzhi thod rgal thob phyir du mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug la rigs mthun thar chags su snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni thod rgal gyi ring sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de la zag bcas kyi ring sbyor dang*/ zag med kyi ring sbyor gnyis/ dang po ni zag bcas kyi snyoms 'jug brgyad pa lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun gnyis su 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

zag med kyi snyoms 'jug brgyad la lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun gnyis su 'jug pa'o// gcig brgal song zhing 'ongs nas ni// zhes pas thod rgal gyi nye sbyor bstan/ (309) de yang dngos gzhi thod rgal thob phyir du mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug la rigs mthun du brgal nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni de'i nye sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de la zag bcas dang zag med kyi nye sbyor rnam pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zag bcas kyi bsam gtan dang po gsum pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ ci yang med rnams la lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun du 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ zag med kyi bsam gtan dang po dang*/ gsum pa sogs bzhi po de la lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun du 'jug pa'o// gong gi tshig rkang gsum pa dang bzhi pas dngos gzhi thod rgal bstan/ de yang thod rgal gyi sbyor ba gnyis sdon du song nas/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug la rigs mi mthun brgal nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin de dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid// de yang bsam gtan dang po zag bcas nas/ gsum pa zag med/ de nas nam mkha' mtha' yas zag bcas/ de nas ci yang med zag med/ de bzhin du ci yang med zag bcas nas nam mkha' mtha' yas zag med sogs lugs mi mthun la yang 'jug pa yin no// gsum pa brgal nas bzhi pa la 'jug mi nus te/ bzhi pa ni shin tu ring ba'i phyir/ rten ni blo gsal bas gling gsum gyi mi'i rten dang*/ gang gi rgyud la ldan pa ni dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i (310) chos can kho na yin te/ rong ṭīka las/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob pa'i mi g.yo ba'i chos can kho nas bskyed do// zhes bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ mi rnams kyi nang kho nar bskyed cing lha dag gi nang du ma yin no// su la skye zhe na/ mi g.yo ba la yin gyi dgra bco pa gzhan la ni ma yin no// zhes pa de thod rgal la yang sbyor rigs pa'i phyir/

bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug 'di dag rten gang la mngon du byed ce na/ 'di dag rang sa dang 'og sa'i rten la mngon du byed pa yod kyi/ gong sa'i rten la 'og sa'i snyoms 'jug mngon du mi byed de/ rten gong ma pas 'og sa'i snyoms 'jug mngon du byed pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang dmigs bsal du srid rtser skyes pa'i 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong gis dgra bcom mngon du byed pa na srid rtse'i sa la zag med med pas ci yang med kyi snyoms 'jug zag med mngon du byas nas srid rtse'i zag pa zad par byed cing*/ de zad ma thag tu dgra bcom thob par 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar yang*/ bsam gtan gzugs med rang dang ni// 'og sa'i rten can 'og dgos med// srid rtse'i 'phags pa ci yang med// mngon du byas nas zag pa zad// ces gsungs so// des na srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug ni zag bcas kho nar nges pas srid rtse'i nyon mongs nam yang spong mi nus la/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs (311) dngos su spong ba'i lam yin na/ zag med yin pas khyab/ sa gzhan gyi nyon mongs spong ba'i lam la zag bcas dang zag med gnyis re yod pa yin te/ 'jig rten 'das kyis srid rtse las// chags bral gzhan las rnam pa gnyis// zhes gong du drangs pa ltar ro// snyoms 'jug gang gis spang bya gang spong ba ni/ dngos gzhi zag med kyis rang gi sa pa dang gong sa'i nyon mongs pa rnams spong nus te/ dper na bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi zag med kyis dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis ka'i nyon mongs spong nus pa nas/ ci yang med kyi zag med kyis ci yang med dang srid rtse'i nyon mongs spong nus pa lta bu'o// dngos gzhi zag bcas kyis ni nyon mongs pa gtan nas mi spong ste/ 'og sa'i nyon mongs ni nyer bsdogs kyis spangs zin pa'i phyir dang*/ rang sa'i nyon mongs kyang mi spong ste/ sred pas srid pa las nges par 'byung mi nus pa'i phyir ro// gong sa'i nyon mongs kyang mi spong ste/

sa 'og mas gong sa'i nyon mongs spong mi nus pa'i phyir ro// nyer bsdogs ni zag med du ma zad dag pa pas kyang 'og sa'i nyon mongs pa spong bar byed de/ 'og sa las 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang*/ zag pa med pas nyon mongs rnams// spong ngo nyer bsdogs dag pas kyang*// zhes so// dngos gzhi brgyad po de dag la 'jug pa'i nyer bsdogs brgyad yod pa yin te/ rang rang gi nyer bsdogs sngon du ma song bar

(312) dngos gzhi de dag mngon du byed mi nus pa'i phyir te/ de dag la ni nyer bsdogs brgyad// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ des na nyer bsdogs kyi ngo bo ni rang gi dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug thob phyir du 'og sa la rags sogs dang*/ gong sa la zhi sogs ci rigs par lta ba'i sgo nas 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i sbyor ba'i snyoms 'jug go /nyer bsdogs de rnams la bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gnyis su yod pa las bar chad med lam ni 'og sa la dmigs nas rags pa dang*/ rtsig pa sogs lta bur dmigs la/ rnam grol lam ni sa gong ma la dmigs nas zhi ba dang gya nom pa nges par 'byung ba'i rnam pa can du lta ba yin te/ 'jig rten pa yi rnam grol dang*// bar chad med lam go rim bzhin// zhi sogs rags sogs rnam pa can// gong dang 'og sa'i spyod yul can// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyer bsdogs kyi ngo bo ni dag pa pa yin te/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs can ni med de/ nyer bsdogs 'di dag ni 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ dmigs bsal du dang po'i nyer bsdogs la ni zag med kyang yod de/ shin tu gsal bas mthong lam sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam thams cad kyi rten du rung ba'i phyir dang*/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med la (313) brten pa'i lam gyis sa rang sa 'og sa gong sa'i nyon mongs thams cad spong nus pa'i phyir te/ zag med mi lcogs med pa yis// thams cad las ni 'dod chags bral// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mi lcogs med kyi don ni/ 'dis spang bya gang yang spong mi nus pa med pas na mi lcogs med dang mi nus pa med ces bya ste/ de ltar rong ṭīka las gsungs pa ni tshad mar bya rigs so// snyoms 'jug rnams rten gang la rgyu gang gis bskyed tshul ni/

rgyu dang las dang chos nyid gsum gyis snyoms 'jug rnams bskyed par byed la/ de yang gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug ni rgyu'i stobs dang las kyi stobs gang rung gis bskyed de/ dang po ni mi'i rten la srid rtse'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa las nyams te/ srid rtse man chad kyi gzugs dang gzugs med gang rung du skyes pa na sngon goms pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyus srid rtse'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa las kyi stobs kyis bskyed pa ni/ mi'i rten la srid rtse yang phyi ma la skye nges kyi las byas sngar bzhin gzugs khams dang gzugs med dang po gsum gang rung du skyes pa na srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug thob nas phyi ma der skye nges pa lta bu'o// gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og sar gong ma'i bsam gtan rnams rgyu dang las dang chos nyid kyis kyang skye ste/ rgyu dang las kyis skye ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa des rtogs nus/ chos nyid kyis skye ba ni snod bcud kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa'i tshe bsam gtan dang po pa'i lha rnams la gnyis (314) pa'i snyoms 'jug chos nyid kyis skyes te bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas su 'gro/ de bzhin du 'og ma 'og ma'i rten la gong ma'i snyoms 'jug chos nyid kyis skyes nas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lha rnams gsum pa dang*/ gsum pa'i lha rnams bzhi par 'gro ba yin no// de ltar yang*/ khams gnyis dag tu gzugs med pa// rgyu dang las kyis stobs kyis skye// gzugs kyi khams su bsam gtan rnams// de dag dang chos nyid kyis kyang*// zhes gsungs so// chos nyid kyis thob pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug de yang rgyu chos nyid kho nar ma nges te/ dngos kyi rgyu chos nyid kyis thob pas de ltar du bzhag la/ chos nyid kyis thob pa'i rgyu de yang las la thug pas don la las dang chos nyid gnyis kas bskyed dgos so// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba la/

gsum tshan du dbye ba dang*/ bzhi tshan du dbye ba dang gnyis/ dang po la sa'i sgo nas rtog dpyod dang bcas pa'i dang*/ rtog pa med la dpyod pa tsam dang bcas pa'i dang*/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ dang po ni bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po pa dang*/ de'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med do// gnyis pa ni dngos gzhi khyad par can lta bu'o// gsum pa ni bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad kyi dngos gzhi rnams so// lam gyi sgo nas dbye na/ stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nyer len gyi phung po la dmigs nas stong pa dang (315) bdag med par lta ba'i ti nge 'dzin to// gnyis pa ni/ mtshan ma bcu dang bral ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la dmigs nas 'gog pa'i rnam pa bzhi po gang rung dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// gsum pa ni/ 'dus byas la dmigs nas sdug kun gyi rnam pa drug dang*/ lam gyi rnam pa bzhi po gang rung gi rnam par can gyi ting nge 'dzin to// de ltar yang*/ mtshan med zhi ba'i rnam pa dang*// zhes pa nas dri med rnam thar sgo gsum mo// zhes so// gsum pa snyoms 'jug la brten pa'i yon tan la/ tshad med/ rnam thar/ zad par/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched dang bzhi/ dang po la byams pa tshad med sogs bzhi yod de/ tshad med pa ni/ bzhi yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa rnam thar la sdug pa'i rnam thar/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba/ gzugs med bzhi'i rnam thar/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang brgyad yod de/ rnam par thar brgyad dang po gnyis// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa zad par ni/ bar chad med par rgyas shing khyab par byed pas na zad par te/ dbye na sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang*/ sngon po dang ser po dang*// dmar po dang dkar po dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ rnam par shes pa la dmigs pa'i zad par bcu yod de/

zad par bcu'o brgyad ma chags// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched la dbyibs zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched bzhi dang*/ kha dog zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched bzhi ste brgyad yod de/ de ltar yang*/ zil gyis gnon (316) pa'i skye mched brgyad// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa yin no// ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched la sogs pa 'di dag kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge mdzad pa'i sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed kyi skabs brgyad pa dang*/ chos mngon pa'i brjod don rags rim gyi snying po kun mkhyen bla mas ji snyed shes bya'i sgo 'byed du yang gsungs pas thar pa don gnyer dag gis de dag la legs par sbyangs shing zab cing rgya che ba'i blo gros kyis blo gsal kun la 'doms shing khyab par bya ba yin no// 'dir smras pa/ 'di dag rang nyid legs bshad goms phyir dang*// skal mnyam gzhan la'ang phan phyir bgyis pa la// bstan pa'i gtso bo ston pa thub dbang dang*// dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis thugs rjes ring du skyongs// e ma shes bya'i mdzod gcig chos mngon gzhung*// rgya chen dam pa'i chos kyi 'jug ngogs 'dir// blo ldan gang gis brtson pas zhugs gyur na// rab 'byams shes bya'i mtha' kun yud kyis mthong*// 'di na blo gsal rnam dpyod ldan pa su// ji snyed chos kyi sgo 'di ma phye bar// thub gsung yangs par lta ba'i mig bgrad kyang*// legs bshad rnam bkra'i ri bo su yis mthong*// 'di de mkhas pa kun gyi bgrod pa'i lam// ngag gi 'dod pa'i jo ba'i dpal nyid du// byed pos sprul bzhin ngag gi sgron me 'di// 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang ming gis legs par sbyar// gzhung don brda 'chad mang po'i dbyangs bdun 'khrol// mtha' dpyad (317) rigs pa'i rgyan gyi phreng bas mdzes// dka' ba'i gnas la dogs bkod de yi lan// mkhas rnams dges pa'i gtam skyes 'di na ko

/bdag nyid byis pa'i blo mig nyams chung bas// ma rtogs 'khrul ba'i nongs pa ci mchis pa// thog ma med bsags sdig dang lhan cig tu// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi spyan sngar bshags// 'dir 'bad dge ba mkha' ltar yangs pa dang*/ dri bral ston gyi zla ltar dkar ba dang*// rnam mang rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed thob pa des// ma gyur thar pa'i grong du 'jug par shog /de ltar dam pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi spyi don ji snyed shes bya'i gsal byed ngag gi sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni rnam dag tshul khrims kyi dri bsung gis skye dgu'i gdung ba sel bar mdzad pa mkhan chen rin po che 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang*/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pa mkhan chen rin po che 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang phyug dpa' bzang rnams kyi zhabs pad gtsug gis bsten cing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs pas blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad gsal ba shākya'i dge slong sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi mdzod rtsa 'grel/ kun mkhyen rong ston chen po'i rnam bshad shes bya rab gsal/ mkhas pa gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad shes bya'i mdzod/ kun mkhyen bla ma bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar gsum ldan/ ji snyed shes bya'i sgo 'byed/ rgyal ba mus rab 'byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i mdzod ṭīka chen mo/ skyed tshal ba kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer pas mdzad pa'i spyi don legs bshad rin po che'i (318) 'byung gnas/ yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i spyi don chen mo shes bya rnam gsal rnams la brten nas chu mo bya'i lo zla ba dgu pa'i yar tshes bcu la dpal bzang ldan gyi bya 'dab spu dkar bla brang rdzong du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/

khyad par lung dang rigs pa'i bshad grwa phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yung ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // 1$0000220༈ /bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las gu rus spel/// /1$0000270
